correctness.rationale: Product Laplacian separation gives a_t(0)=1 and (L_h+2tI)a_t=0 off the origin for a face Walsh character of weight t; the grounded Dirichlet system is invertible. At t=0 the multiplier is constant. At t>0 it is the resolvent column divided by its diagonal. Cubical Walsh orthogonality gives G_t(0,0)=2^(−h)Σ_j binom(h,j)/(2(j+t)) and (G_t²)(0,0)=2^(−h)Σ_j binom(h,j)/(4(j+t)²); their normalized ratio is exactly the stated Gram eigenvalue. The killed-walk representation gives strict decrease in t off the origin, since the first hit is finite and strictly positive there. The constant sector has squared norm factor 2^h. Parseval host analysis leaves the Gram unchanged. In the remaining t=1 maximization, cross-multiplying F_(n+1)<F_n with z=2^n gives C_nT_n>R_n. Summing the quadratic truncation of 1/(n−r) with weights 2^(n−r)−1 gives the stated U_n; expanding U_nC_n−R_n and using 2^n≥n³/2 gives the positive bound in the proof for n≥8 (the negative parenthesis is bounded above by 43). Exact small values then give the unique maximum at h=4. An independent radial solve there gives a_0 through a_4 equal to (1,13/62,8/93,3/62,1/31); summing binomial-weighted squares gives 3548/2883. All nonzero equality data are in the weight-one sector at h=4; the zero input of course gives trivial equality at any h. Finite rational replay independently reproduced all seven low-codimension values. The supplied NumPy checker was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: Counting, not normalized probability, norms; arbitrary boundary shapes and non-Parseval host analysis are outside scope. The nonzero qualification in the equality statement is needed to distinguish extremizers from the trivial zero vector.

value.rationale: The result separates the unbounded constant-sector amplification from uniformly controlled mean-zero stability in a motivated graph-to-host lift. The optimal constant and exact equality tell which embedding depth and which face modes give the worst amplification, independent of k and of the host Parseval representation. The nontrivial new maximization over infinitely many codimensions, rather than merely the known scalar table or general harmonic completion, supplies that benchmark.
residual_risks: Not a theorem about arbitrary graph embeddings or a bound on Dirichlet energy; no claim about an optimal minimal host.
